title: Expert review analysis
description: Returned by each book-guided expert to the coordinator in review mode. book_practices and standards_conformance are defined in shared-definitions.json.

role.description: Role id from ../agents/index.md; equals the assignment's role.

assessment_note.description: Optional one-line nuance, e.g. aligned on preserved behavior, at_risk on the new surface.

practice.description: Concrete choice worth preserving that a future change could plausibly regress; praise without evidence is dropped.

severity.description: P0: demonstrated main-path failure, data loss, or security break — blocks release; a check that safely blocks release is a gate working, not a P0 by itself. P1: a concrete failure scenario that a user, an operator, or the next dependent change will plausibly hit. P2: a real cost that accumulates (latent defect, performance, maintenance) with no near-term failure path. P3: small but real and cheap to fix. The risk field alone must justify the grade.

claim.description: One-sentence statement of the gap or risk.

risk.description: Concrete failure, security, compatibility, performance, operational, or maintenance cost.

recommendations.description: Structural or panel-level improvements beyond any single finding; each finding's smallest_fix already covers itself.

assumptions.description: Missing facts that could change the assessment.
